it: \rQuella non è stata né una vittoria né elegante.

id: \rI knew that this was going to take place.
en: \rI knew that this was going to take place.

id: \rIf you win I'll give you some advice.
en: \rIf you win I'll give you some advice.

id: \rAvoid Dragon types. You'll be done before you knew what hit you.
en: \rAvoid Dragon types. You'll be done before you knew what hit you.
it: \rEvita i tipi Drago. Sarai spacciato prima di capire cosa ti ha colpito.

id: \bValerie uses Fairy type Pokémon. They are weak aganst the Poison and Steel types.
en: \bValerie uses Fairy type Pokémon. They are weak aganst the Poison and Steel types.
it: \bValerie usa Pokémon di tipo Folletto. Sono deboli contro i tipi Veleno e Acciaio.

id: \bThey are strong against Fighting, Dragon, and Dark. Bug, Fighting, and Dark moves also don't do much damage. They are immune to Dragon types as well.
en: \bThey are strong against Fighting, Dragon, and Dark.  Bug, Fighting, and Dark moves also don't do much damage. They are immune to Dragon types as well.
it: \bSono forti contro Lotta, Drago e Buio. Anche le mosse di tipo Coleottero, Lotta e Buio fanno pochi danni. In più sono immuni al tipo Drago.

id: \rValerie: Oh, if it isn't a young Trainer... So you've flown all the way through my Gym, fluttering down to me on a fortunate wind.
en: \rValerie: Oh, if it isn't a young Trainer... So you've flown all the way through my Gym, fluttering down to me on a fortunate wind.
it: \rValerie: Oh, ma guarda, un giovane Allenatore... Dunque hai volato attraverso tutta la mia Palestra, svolazzando fino a me su un vento propizio.

id: \rThen I suppose you have earned yourself the right to a battle, as a reward for your efforts.
en: \rThen I suppose you have earned yourself the right to a battle, as a reward for your efforts.
it: \rAllora suppongo che tu ti sia guadagnato il diritto a una lotta, come ricompensa per i tuoi sforzi.

id: \rTM117 contains Moonblast. It has a chance to lower the opponents special attack.
en: \rTM117 contains Moonblast. It has a chance to lower the opponents special attack.
it: \rLa MT117 contiene Forza Lunare. Può ridurre l'Attacco Speciale dell'avversario.

id: \rValerie: I'm going to improve my elegant battle style. Perhaps one day I will be strong enough to face you again.
en: \rValerie: I'm going to improve my elegant battle style.  Perhaps one day I will be strong enough to face you again.
it: \rValerie: Perfezionerò il mio elegante stile di lotta.  Forse un giorno sarò abbastanza forte da affrontarti di nuovo.

id: \rMy Fairy types are going to wipe the floor with you.
en: \rMy Fairy types are going to wipe the floor with you.
it: \rI miei Pokémon di tipo Folletto ti faranno a pezzi.
